a.speaker: A crashed sedan
a.text: A sedan coasted into a light pole when its steering assist died. The driver's door is crumpled shut and a young man inside is pinned at the knee, calling out in Spanish and then in English for anyone.

options.text: Pry the door with the tools from your trunk.
effects: You pried Rafael Ochoa out of his car on TV Highway.

options.text: Brace his leg and talk him through it while two others pull the door.
effects: You and two strangers freed Rafael Ochoa on TV Highway.

options.text: Leave him. Your family is out there.

pry_fail.speaker: A crashed sedan
pry_fail.text: The bar slips twice and the door doesn't move. A nurse coming off shift at the clinic down the road takes over and gets him out; you hold the light. It takes an hour. (A missed gate costs time, never the scene.)

brace_fail.speaker: A crashed sedan
brace_fail.text: You don't know how to brace it and he screams when they pull. He's out, though, and breathing. It takes an hour you didn't have.

freed.speaker: Rafael Ochoa
freed.text:
He's out, white-faced, holding your sleeve. "Rafael. Ochoa. I live by the fairgrounds. If you need something, I'm the guy with the welding truck that doesn't work anymore."

Strangers help at crashes. Most people, most of the time, do.

left.speaker: A crashed sedan
left.text: You walk on. Behind you, someone else stops. You don't look back to see if it was enough.

done.speaker: A crashed sedan
done.text: The sedan sits empty against the pole.
